comment: Every Terraform root under stacks/ and how the nightly drift plan (.github/workflows/drift-plan.yml) and the PR plan/apply workflow (.github/workflows/terraform.yml) treat it. scripts/drift-stacks.py refuses a stacks/ directory that is not listed here. apply=true: terraform.yml applies the stack on merge to trunk (the demo environment); any other stack is applied only through its own runbook. A standing entry tolerates ONE exact provider artifact and must link the issue that removes it.

aws-candidate-preflight.apply_note: Applied only through scripts/candidate-preflight-plan-apply.sh (runbook/candidate-preflight-v1.md); PR plans show its diff, the apply job never touches it.

aws-db-migration-runner.reason: Reviewed but never applied: no state object and no function exist. The drift check asserts both stay absent; a state object or function appearing outside a reviewed apply is drift. Applying it is governed by scripts/db-migration-runner-plan-apply.sh, not by the apply workflow.
